subject_hint: Bill Withers — Use Me (1972) — The groove under Withers's vocal belongs to drummer James Gadson, with Melvin Dunlap on bass and Ray Jackson on clavinet; on Still Bill the three also share production credits. Notes: Production credit is on the album page (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Still_Bill): Withers and Ray Jackson on all tracks; Blackmon, Dunlap and Gadson on tracks 1–10. Check that Use Me is one of tracks 1–10. The album page says the musicians came from the Watts 103rd Street Rhythm Band but does not name which ones: do not tie Gadson to the band without a second source. Single release month conflicts (August vs September 1972).
artist: Bill Withers; James Gadson (drums, percussion), with Melvin Dunlap (bass) and Ray Jackson (clavinet)
